capture.title: Measure and grade
capture.guideTitle: Fit all four corners in frame
capture.guideHint: Hold the phone parallel to the mat, straight down

steps.1: Place the calibration mat on a flat surface
steps.2: Put the fruit inside the measurement area

capture.cameraDenied: Camera unavailable. Allow access in your browser settings, or choose a photo from the gallery.
capture.chooseFruitHint: Pick the fruit you want to measure and grade
capture.chooseMatHint: Pick the sheet you printed — its marker spacing sets the scale
capture.sampleHint: Simulated capture — 64 longan with a true mean of 28.4 mm. See a full result before printing a sheet.
capture.playFailed: Could not start the camera preview. Close and reopen, or use “choose from gallery”.
capture.lowRes: The browser camera gives {{size}}, which is too small — go back and use “choose from gallery” to shoot with the native camera.

result.title: Measurement result
result.occludedNote: Occluded fruit are counted but not measured or graded — a clipped outline under-reads the diameter.
result.notHeightCorrected: Fruit height not compensated — diameters read high.
result.noFruit: No fruit found in the measurement area
result.skinRelative: Compared within this photo only — there is no established standard mapping colour to a quality class yet.
result.skinUncal: Colour strip could not be read; values are raw camera readings and are not comparable across photos.

history.title: Measurement history
history.emptyHint: Tap “Measure” to run your first one

settings.title: Settings
settings.gradingWarning: These thresholds are defaults. Confirm them against the TAS standard or your buyer before grading fruit for sale.
settings.matPrintWarning: Print at 100% — no scaling. Measure the 100 mm bar with a ruler before use.
settings.serverHint: Paste the tunnel URL running on your machine. Takes effect immediately — no redeploy.
settings.serverEmpty: Not configured — the app runs in demo mode with simulated figures
settings.serverMatMismatch: Warning: the server's mat geometry does not match this app

common.mockMode: Demo mode — no server connected, figures are simulated

landing.lede: Photograph fruit on the calibration mat with your phone. The system measures every fruit in millimetres and grades it automatically.
landing.p1: Reads ArUco markers for true scale — measured, not estimated
landing.p2: Diameter in millimetres, with automatic counting
landing.p3: Grades against thresholds you can set per buyer
landing.footnote: Requires the calibration mat printed at 100%
